title: Autonomous System Safety Analyzer — Overview and definition
t: Autonomous System Safety Analyzer — Overview and definition
description: Identifies hazards and checks safety constraints for autonomous systems.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Identifies hazards and checks safety constraints for autonomous systems. A safety analyzer applies STPA, HAZOP, and fault-tree methods to autonomous systems, verifying safety constraints on perception, planning, and actuation. Real implementations are safety-case tools (Adelard ASCE, Ansys medini) plus custom STPA pipelines. It tracks hazards to mitigations to verification evidence. Engineering safety use only.

title: Autonomous System Safety Analyzer — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Autonomous System Safety Analyzer — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Identifies hazards and checks safety constraints for autonomous systems.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Autonomous System Safety Analyzer, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (STPA control-structure and unsafe-control-action analysis). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: STPA control-structure and unsafe-control-action analysis and Hazard and fault-tree modeling. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Fault-tree analysis tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
